local function formatISO8601(datum, time)
    local year = datum:sub(1, 4)
    local month = datum:sub(5, 6)
    local day = datum:sub(7, 8)
    local hour = time:sub(1, 2)
    local minute = time:sub(3, 4)
    local second = time:sub(5, 6)

    return string.format("%s-%s-%sT%s:%s:%sZ", year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
end

return formatISO8601(wf.vars.DATUM, wf.vars.TIME)

    end
